But the function briefs_display_cases will display briefs for the given case IDs. So we need to provide the case IDs. Let's do: call court_records_search_cases for New York with query "theft", year 2021, limit 5. Then call for San Francisco with same. Then combine the case IDs from both results. Then take first 5 unique IDs. Then call briefs_display_cases with those IDs. That should satisfy.
